notes.title: Enrage Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45413376/d0a88f6c6b66cf0a871aeb2d5fa4fb59a4ee8ce1.png[/img]
[h3]Fight tougher and even more deadly enemies in the Enrage Update!
[/h3]

When drafting dungeon deck cards, there is a small chance an enemy will become enraged! These enemies have more health and deal even more damage! If you are able to defeat these brutal monsters, you will be rewarded with equipment and gold! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45413376/863a3aa7cb7bcedd95a3f005a4334e6574dece23.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 0.9.56 Endless Mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45413376/f5ff797936e22f14b0357806ff6f28ed5a695753.png[/img]

After defeating Ulag'bol, you are now able to continue playing with the new Endless Mode.

Endless Mode continues the journey right where you left off, meaning your deck, equipment, potions, and even the difficulty are carried over! Every battle in Endless Mode is tougher than the last! Jump in now and see how far you can make it!
